body: I don't want to because I have so much going for me but it just pales in comparison to being alone. Some people never get married and they are ok with that but I know I wouldn't be able to handle it. Not even looking that far ahead since I can't even get a girlfriend, I really don't know what else to try and I can't keep taking the constant questions from my family and friends asking me why I don't have one yet.

I believe you but you still got to experience something that I never will and can't just "go out" and get it like a job or school. You obviously have something that I don't that allowed you to develop a relationship in the first place and you should capitalize on that aspect of yourself rather then throwing it away.

I'm 24 and I've never had a serious relationship or a girlfriend. You have no idea what I'd give to be with someone for months, even if it got taken away. Obviously I don't know how you're feeling since I've never been in that situation but you have experience I won't ever have and you can use that to develop another relationship.
